label: PF Backlog 503
title: Defect: core.agent_structure.KNOWN_AGENTS is stale (missing ux-ia/implement-*/design_critic) - derive from agent cards
body:
## Problem / why
`core/agent_structure.py` `KNOWN_AGENTS` is STALE: it omits real agents that have cards (ux-ia, implement-ui,
implement-api, implement-db, implement-logic, design_critic, ...). Anything validating against it (e.g. the new
artifact map BI-PF-0765) rejects legitimate agents.

## Goal & value
One authoritative agent list, derived from the agent cards (agents/*.agent.json), used by validators.

## Acceptance criteria
- KNOWN_AGENTS (or a replacement source) equals the set of agents/*.agent.json ids.
- Validators use the authoritative set; a test asserts agents-with-cards are all "known".

## In scope
Reconcile KNOWN_AGENTS with the agent cards.

## Out of scope
Changing the pipeline stage order.

## Verification
Test: every agents/*.agent.json id is in the authoritative set; artifact-map validates against it (already does).

brief.problem: core.agent_structure.KNOWN_AGENTS omits real agents that have cards (ux-ia, implement-*, design_critic), so validators reject legitimate agents
brief.what_adds: an authoritative agent set derived from agents/*.agent.json used by validators
brief.why: so validation never rejects a real agent due to a stale hand-maintained list
brief.who_feels: any gate/validator that references the agent set

objective: the known-agents source equals the agents/*.agent.json ids and validators use it
acceptance_criteria: KNOWN_AGENTS (or replacement) equals the agent-card id set
a test asserts every agent card id is known
approach: derive the authoritative set from agents/*.agent.json (single source) instead of a hand list
verification: test: every agents/*.agent.json id is in the authoritative set
risks: other code relies on KNOWN_AGENTS ordering

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/agent_capabilities.py, core/agent_card_loader.py, core/agent_hierarchy.py, core/agent_ledger.py
